motivation: v0.2 peer-review proposal: prune the 5,990-col RRR basis to ~164 physics-projected LF/spatial features (16 macro-modes + 2x68 station residuals), shrink toward a fixed 3-band kriging prior w0 instead of zero, and replace the tail taper with a horizon-growing envelope; expected to raise clean-origin forward skill above +3.39% by removing >200uHz 'timestamp fingerprinting' columns.
implementation: scripts/lib/rrr_pruned_basis.py + /tmp/pruned_probe.py; identical corpus (40 windows <= 1793132392), identical member-Gram convention (fit-half, r_f = lev - b_pre), identical decay ring (K=16, hl=1.25), identical scoring (pure correction, demeaned, +-8 m clip) as the committed clean arm.

clean_origin_arm.verdict: uniformly negative at every lambda; the w0 kriging blend is a large anti-correction

deployed_regime_holdout_grams_pct_by_lam.verdict: pruned basis retains ~23% of retrodiction skill at best; the 'noise' columns carry the map

diagnostics.mechanism: macro kriging modes correlate with the ramp-inclusive holdout target (+0.35) but ~0 with the level-anchored fit-half target; the regime gap, not HF fingerprinting, bounds clean-origin transfer

conclusion: The reviewer's prescription is refuted on the pinned corpus: pruning to LF spatial macro-modes does not raise the clean-origin forward component (uniformly negative, -19..-98%) and loses ~77% of deployed-regime skill (+9.82% best vs +42.66%). The high-frequency per-station columns carry the genuine spatial map — consistent with the station-permutation null (z~6-7), which proves that map is spatially specific rather than epoch-fingerprint noise. The +2.6-3.4% clean-origin ceiling is set by the fit/holdout regime gap plus the ~90-min coherence bound, not by basis dimensionality.
caveat: one implementation of the proposed basis; the w0 arm result is implementation-independent (their formula), and the sign-flip mechanism is structural
